question: How do I keep the Obsidian graph readable and what should notes be named?

retrieved.text: To see only curated notes, filter the graph with the path filter wiki/ and turn off the Attachments toggle. Zoom in until the labels are readable.

Name notes for their subject in two to six words, such as Retrieval Augmented Generation. Never use hashes, timestamps, or full sentences as filenames, because the filename is the label shown in the graph view.
Open the vault folder itself in Obsidian, not the whole code repository. Keep untouched originals in raw/, reviewed notes in wiki/, and a human landing page called index.md at the vault root.

answer: To see only curated notes, filter the graph with the path filter wiki/ and turn off the Attachments toggle, and then zoom in until the labels are readable [1]. Notes should be named for their subject in two to six words, such as Retrieval Augmented Generation, and never use hashes, timestamps, or full sentences as filenames because the filename is the label shown in the graph view [2].
